inlines.v: INSURMOUNT'ABLE, adjective 1. Insuperable; that cannot be surmounted or overcome; as an insurmountable difficulty, obstacle or impedient. 2. Not to be surmounted; not to be passed by ascending; as an insurmountable wall or rampart.
